doc: Start sites of the training bots (owner, 2026-11-02: good training locations, decimals ignored). Bot k of every shard starts every episode at sites[k], so bot k of shard 0 and bot k of shard 1 form a pair: the same seed, the same start, different worlds (self-imitation). Training world seed 20261101. y = the standing cell measured on the fresh world (run train6, events site_moved): the owner's y with the decimals cut was one block low at sites 1, 2 and 4 (70.97 -> 71) and one high at sites 3 and 10. src/rl/run_skill_env.js --sites.
